bio: Housed within a stunning Georgian building, Dukes Head Hotel is situated in the beautiful market town of Kings Lynn in Norfolk, providing the perfect base to enjoy Afternoon Tea after exploring this picturesque town.  Afternoon Tea is served in the stylish Turners Restaurant, offering a relaxing atmosphere to enjoy a selection of delicious sweet and savoury treats.  A carefully crafted wine list is on offer, while the afternoon teas pair delicate fingers sandwiches with warm scones, pastries, and a range of teas.
